# RTXCR Hair Material Source Notice

The HLSL files in this directory were copied from NVIDIA RTXCR commit
`2bd10cff0824cbd18195339d4dc6987c0fe5a5bc`.

Only the individual RTXCR hair-material files carrying the MIT permission
notice are included:

- `HairMaterial.hlsli`
- `HairChiangBSDF.hlsli`
- `utils/RtxcrMath.hlsli`
- `utils/RtxcrBsdf.hlsli`
- `utils/RtxcrHairBsdfHelper.hlsli`

Their original copyright and license headers are preserved in each file.
RTXCR geometry and sample glue use different terms and are not copied here.
VividRP-owned integration and geometry code lives outside this Vendor folder.
